note: Work: the Employment Act, 2000 (No. 6 of 2000), section 21(1): no person under fourteen may be employed or work in any public or private agricultural, industrial or non-industrial undertaking, save work in homes and in vocational schools or training institutions (section 21(2)); section 22 bars 14 to 18 from harmful work. The Act makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below fourteen (my reading). Read from the Ministry of Labour's copy. Majority: the Constitution's copy on the Government portal (malawi.gov.mw) is the text before the 2017 amendment and sets marriage at 15 to 18 with consent, not majority; no statute on majority was found (MalawiLII put this client behind a Cloudflare check, and Parliament's site too); left null. Service: no conscription law was found and the Malawi Defence Force's pages weren't read; left null.
